theme_strategy: Luxury Dark (Primary) with extreme contrast and architectural precision
brand_philosophy: Build in Silence. A $100M Venture Creation Company. COMPASS: Direction, Clarity, Conviction, Precision, Purpose, Long-term Thinking.

headings.style: Elegant, timeless, tight tracking for large text

layouts.general: Asymmetric, editorial, predominantly left-aligned. Extreme breathing room and negative space.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32, py-40 for vertical section padding. Containers must not feel cramped.
layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. Compass logo centerpiece. On-load masked line-by-line staggered text reveal.
layouts.services_pillars: 5 premium pillars. AVOID standard SaaS cards. Use flat, structural partitions with massive typography (01, 02) and left-aligned editorial content. Use 1px borders for separation.
layouts.process_journey: Vertical timeline map (Direction → Validation → Blueprint → Execution → Growth → Investment). Clean, connected, austere.
layouts.manifesto_why: Editorial chapters. Huge quotes, vast negative space, slow marquee integration.
layouts.contact: Minimalist luxury form. 1px bottom borders for inputs, no standard boxes.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #2A2A2A to create grid-like precision and architectural structure.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Avoid 'SaaS' soft shadows. Use stark contrast. Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for nav.
visual_enhancers.imagery: Desaturated or black and white. Abstract architectural shadows, precision engineering.

motion.reveals: Framer Motion. Masked line-by-line reveal (y: 100% to 0, clip-path or overflow hidden). Premium scroll reveals.
motion.interactions: Subtle desaturation on hover, slight scale down of images, line expansions for links. No bouncy effects.

components.navigation: Sticky, minimal. Logo left, links right. background-color: #050505/90 with backdrop-blur-md on scroll.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none) or very slight radius (rounded-sm). 1px border. Hover: invert colors (bg-ivory text-black).
components.inputs: Highly customized: transparent background, 1px bottom border, no side/top borders. Focus: border-ivory.
components.marquee: Slow, editorial serif marquee. Massive text. Divider lines.

hero_abstract.description: Black and white abstract shadows for hero backdrop or manifesto section

office_luxury.description: Dark wood, luxury office interior for About or Service sections

precision_engineering.description: Minimalist black and white architectural precision for Process section

glass_dark.description: Dark room with clear glass wall for contact or footer backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use blue, gradients, stock illustrations, or default Tailwind colors. Stick STRICTLY to the defined hex codes.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond and body uses Outfit. Load from Google Fonts.
Avoid the 'startup SaaS' aesthetic. No random floating cards with heavy drop shadows. Use 1px borders and flat architectural layouts.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).
Implement Framer Motion for line-by-line staggered text reveals on load.
Ensure Lenis is set up for smooth scrolling.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky nav when content scrolls underneath. Use solid #050505 or #050505 with backdrop-blur.
For the Service section, build it as a list of premium pillars rather than a generic grid of cards.
For the Process section, design a vertical journey layout with timeline indicators.
Do not use generic icons. Rely on typography, lines, and the curated images.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs for a luxurious feel.
Prioritize using existing UI components but highly customize their styles.
Use sonner for toasts if needed.
